name: Height Curve Activation & Voxel Column Generation
definition: Transforms a normalized noise heightmap into a 3D voxel column structure by applying a hyperbolic tangent activation function, clamping to a water line, scaling to world units, and stacking voxels from a ground offset to the calculated height.
summary: Height Curve Activation & Voxel Column Generation transforms 2D noise into 3D voxel columns using a hyperbolic tangent activation to smooth terrain and explicitly handle color mapping based on discrete bands.
